semantic_atoms.observed: Titan is deprecated and redirects to LCME; Titan/TitanConfig/get_titan/TITAN_DB are compatibility aliases over LCME components.

LCME composes SQLite storage, a vector store and a knowledge graph, runs background maintenance, invalidates retrieval cache on ingest, maintains a hot buffer for non-chat origins, and routes retrieval through a mature neural Hippocampus when available before deterministic fallback retrieval.

Unprotected node confidence decays exponentially with a seven-day half-life; old orphan or low-confidence nodes can be pruned; protected/high-utility frequently accessed memories may graduate to permanent protection; edge confidence decays by 5% per maintenance cycle and weak old edges are deleted.

Retrieval combines vector and FTS rankings, time-decayed confidence, recency and graph degree. A mature Neural Cortex may learn retrieval weights after the configured maturity threshold; otherwise fixed relevance-dominant warm/cold weights are used.

semantic_atoms.observed: LCME owns a dedicated SQLiteStore/vector/graph stack and historically points at titan/LCME storage. Porting that storage authority wholesale would create a second durable memory/truth authority beside UnifiedDB; only the mechanisms should be transplanted into the canonical substrate.
semantic_atoms.evidence_scope: architecture compatibility inference grounded in current authority

change: Store canonical observations/claims/events only in UnifiedDB typed tables with causal identity and provenance.
Represent effective_confidence, recency, activation and learned retrieval weights as derived/rebuildable retrieval projections, not fact truth.
Require promotion to protected/permanent memory to preserve source identities and authority class; repeated access cannot convert an uncertain claim into fact.

Replace destructive semantic 'compression' claims with an explicit SourceSet -> DerivedSummary projection only when a summary mechanism exists and retains source lineage; until then call current mechanism pruning/compaction.

Keep vector and graph indexes rebuildable from canonical rows; learned retrieval controllers may rank candidates but may not delete protected evidence or mint canonical claims without deterministic policy gates.
architecture_delta_for_frankenstein_2.retrieval_score_contract: score = relevance/similarity + confidence-salience + recency + graph/activation signals under a versioned policy; score controls retrieval order only, never epistemic truth
architecture_delta_for_frankenstein_2.forgetting_contract: forget/prune affects retrieval/storage retention under explicit policy and provenance; negative evidence, effect journals, authority records and protected causal receipts are outside autonomous learned forgetting
architecture_delta_for_frankenstein_2.consolidation_contract: graduation/protection is a retention-policy transition, not epistemic promotion; semantic consolidation remains OPEN until a lineage-preserving transform is source-proven and tested

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: LCME's strongest reusable contribution is memory salience dynamics, not its standalone database topology.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: A current-authority source proves LCME/titan.db is the admitted canonical UnifiedDB substrate rather than a historical separate store.

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Separating retrieval salience from epistemic confidence prevents access-frequency feedback from hardening repeated but false memories into facts.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: A controlled replay shows a coupled score safely improves retrieval while never altering truth/effect authority across contradictory and repeated false claims.

triggerword4_handoff.instruction: Implement Titan/LCME-derived decay, activation and retrieval ranking inside UnifiedDB projections. Do not instantiate titan.db/LCME as a second canonical memory authority. Preserve source/provenance for every retained or derived memory object.
